settings.description: Main site title shown in browser tab
Owner name for display on home page

Home page background rotation. Each entry is either a path string (centered crop) or an object {"path": ..., "focal": ...} where focal is any CSS background-position (e.g. "left", "right", "25%", "30% 40%") used to pick the best vertical strip when landscape images are cropped on mobile
